method.startup: Navigation to workspace file locator ready; includes driver round trips.
method.discrete: Browser performance.now immediately before DOM user-action event to two requestAnimationFrame callbacks after observable DOM update. Includes rendering opportunities, not a pixel paint or image decode guarantee. No driver time in discrete samples.
method.open: Fresh empty page; file button click to exact rect count and enabled layer-search plus two animation frames. Startup separately recorded.
method.filtering: Alternates exact single-row search and clearing search.
method.drag: rAF intervals across 30 real pointer moves per drag (mousedown dispatched directly to SVG target, matching existing E2E gesture harness), one animation frame awaited per move; initial partial interval omitted. Driver-paced, not unthrottled input throughput.
limits: Development-build baseline; production performance must be separately measured.
Host was not CPU-isolated; retain all outliers and remeasure on same idle host before regression judgment.
No heap trend claim; 20-cycle heap measurement remains D3 work.
